name: Flows
title: flows.sh
shortDescription: Flows is a versatile platform designed to enhance product adoption through user onboarding, feature adoption, and product-led growth strategies. It enables companies to create in-app campaigns, convert free trials to paying customers, and drive key performance indicators without needing extensive engineering resources. An example use case is a SaaS company using Flows to automate their onboarding process, thereby improving user activation and retention.
cons: Potentially steep learning curve for non-tech users
